flows.title: Reply to a conversation
steps: Open the conversation, then click Reply at the bottom of the most recent message, or use the three-dot menu on any message; this replies only to that message's sender.
If the most recent message has multiple recipients, click Reply all instead to send your reply to everyone on that message.

flows.title: Assign a conversation
steps: Open the conversation and click Assign in the conversation toolbar, then pick a teammate from the dropdown; your most recently used assignees show at the top of the list.
To reassign or unassign it later, click the current assignee's name at the top of the conversation and choose Unassigned or a different teammate.

flows.title: Tag a conversation
steps: Click the plus icon at the top of the conversation and select the Tag option from the dropdown.
Type the tag name in the search bar, then pick an existing tag or create a new one; you can add as many tags as you want to the conversation.

flows.title: Find a conversation
steps: Click the search icon at the top of your inbox and type your keywords; press Enter to see the full list of results.
Use the dropdown at the right of the search pop-up to search the inbox you're viewing, everything in your sidebar, or All inboxes.
Narrow further with filters such as tag:tag name, is:unassigned, or assignee:teammate name from the search filter bar or the search builder.
